name: drone-domination
description: Civilization-type game on a Goldberg G(24,0) sphere

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:core && npm run typecheck:client && npm run typecheck:server
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run compile
scripts.build:world: npm run compile && npm run generate:world
scripts.test:fast: node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --pool=threads --no-isolate src/world/__tests__/vec3.test.ts src/world/__tests__/units.test.ts src/world/__tests__/turnState.test.ts src/world/__tests__/combat.test.ts src/world/__tests__/combat.resolve.test.ts src/world/__tests__/combatFormula.test.ts src/world/__tests__/combatFacing.test.ts src/world/__tests__/logisticsPipelineConservation.test.ts src/world/__tests__/logisticsDeliveryTiming.test.ts src/world/__tests__/logisticsConstructionCharging.test.ts src/world/__tests__/logisticsRefineryPlacement.test.ts src/world/__tests__/logisticsRejectionReasons.test.ts src/world/__tests__/logisticsTaskCountdown.test.ts server/__tests__/matchSession.test.ts server/__tests__/repairIntent.test.ts server/__tests__/combatApi.test.ts server/__tests__/logisticsApiIntents.test.ts server/__tests__/logisticsEndTurn.test.ts server/__tests__/logisticsShuttleTransport.test.ts
scripts.test:extended: node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --exclude src/world/__tests__/vec3.test.ts --exclude src/world/__tests__/units.test.ts --exclude src/world/__tests__/turnState.test.ts --exclude src/world/__tests__/combat.test.ts --exclude src/world/__tests__/combat.resolve.test.ts --exclude src/world/__tests__/combatFormula.test.ts --exclude src/world/__tests__/combatFacing.test.ts --exclude src/world/__tests__/logisticsPipelineConservation.test.ts --exclude src/world/__tests__/logisticsDeliveryTiming.test.ts --exclude src/world/__tests__/logisticsConstructionCharging.test.ts --exclude src/world/__tests__/logisticsRefineryPlacement.test.ts --exclude src/world/__tests__/logisticsRejectionReasons.test.ts --exclude src/world/__tests__/logisticsTaskCountdown.test.ts --exclude server/__tests__/matchSession.test.ts --exclude server/__tests__/repairIntent.test.ts --exclude server/__tests__/combatApi.test.ts --exclude server/__tests__/logisticsApiIntents.test.ts --exclude server/__tests__/logisticsEndTurn.test.ts --exclude server/__tests__/logisticsShuttleTransport.test.ts
